clue.text: Actually went round new ride with old Australian instrument

indicators.note: round says the phrase wraps itself around the next piece

parts.note: to say someone actually went is to say they did go, the emphatic form

indicators.note: new asks for a fresh arrangement of the letters of ride

explanation.surface: Someone really did travel round a fresh ride while carrying an old instrument from Australia.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Actually went' is the emphatic 'did go', which 'round' opens up; 'new' scrambles ride before it goes in.
explanation.definitionFit: This long wooden drone pipe is the traditional wind instrument of Aboriginal Australians.

clue.text: What female impersonators assume is an obstacle to progress?

definitions.meaning: men dressing as women for performance are said to wear this kind of costume
something holding you back or slowing you down

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both women's clothing worn by male performers and a hindrance that slows movement.

clue.text: State of Parisian going over Cambridge college

indicators.note: in a down clue, one piece going over another sits above it, so it comes first

parts.note: de is the French word for of
Clare is a college of Cambridge University

explanation.surface: A Frenchman's statement about a Cambridge college he is touring.
explanation.definitionFit: To state something is to declare it, so the verb sense matches.

clue.text: Leaders I had three times to recast, to do this?

definitions.text: Leaders I had three times to recast, to do this?

indicators.note: recast means cast in a new shape, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: the letter I taken three times over
taken as written

explanation.surface: An editor complains about having had to rewrite the lead articles three times.
explanation.walkthrough: 'recast' rearranges LEADERS plus III plus TO; the whole clue also defines, since leaders are newspaper editorials and writing them is what the answer means.
explanation.definitionFit: Leaders are editorial articles, and to compose such opinion pieces is to write editorially, so the clue describes the activity.

clue.text: Natural to announce one's selected for boat race

indicators.note: to announce something is to say it aloud, so the phrase is heard rather than read

parts.note: a rower chosen for a racing crew of eight is said to be in the eight

explanation.surface: Being picked for the rowing crew seems to come naturally.
explanation.walkthrough: IN EIGHT, said aloud, sounds like the answer; a racing boat in rowing is an eight.
explanation.definitionFit: Something innate is inborn, hence natural rather than learned.

clue.text: Alert writer easily loses heart dipping into dictionary

indicators.note: dipping into says the pieces go inside the dictionary's letters

parts.note: OED is the Oxford English Dictionary
a pen is a writing instrument

indicators.note: losing its heart, the word easily drops its middle letters

explanation.surface: A careful writer who has lost his nerve dips into a dictionary.
explanation.walkthrough: 'loses heart' keeps only the first and last letters of easily; 'dipping into' sends writer and that pair inside the dictionary's initials.
explanation.definitionFit: Being wide awake and watchful, with eyes open, is to be alert.

clue.text: Initially stuck with label, one may get in a rut

definitions.text: one may get in a rut

indicators.note: initially points to the first letter of stuck

parts.note: a tag is a label

explanation.surface: A stuck label leaves someone feeling trapped in a rut.
explanation.walkthrough: The rut here is the deer's mating season, not a groove in a road.
explanation.definitionFit: A male deer takes part in the autumn rut, its breeding season.

clue.text: I convey food across river with little hesitation

indicators.note: the food goes across the river, so it surrounds it

parts.note: tuck is British slang for food, especially snacks
er is the small noise of hesitating

explanation.surface: Someone hesitantly carries food over a river.
explanation.definitionFit: A lorry driver transports goods, so the first person 'I convey' describes one.

clue.text: Plant sported by Billy? It depends

definitions.meaning: a meadow flower with a fluffy seed head
a billy goat wears hair hanging from its chin, and depend means hang down

explanation.definitionFit: It is the name of a meadow plant and, literally, the hanging chin tuft of a billy goat.

clue.text: Even when business is slack, one may have a lot to sell

definitions.text: Even when business is slack, one may have a lot to sell

parts.words: Even when business is slack, one may have a lot to sell
parts.note: a lot is an item put up at a sale room, so a person running a sale always has lots on offer

explanation.definitionFit: A person conducting sales at a sale room offers items called lots to bidders.

clue.text: Return something sold by swindler that's not yet adult

indicators.note: return asks for the phrase to be read backwards

parts.note: to be sold a pup is to be swindled with something worthless

explanation.surface: Someone tries to give back a young animal a swindler sold them.
explanation.definitionFit: An insect in its chrysalis stage is not yet an adult.

clue.text: Absurd notice displayed outside theatre by old American

indicators.note: the notice is shown outside, so it surrounds the theatre

parts.note: a poster is a public notice
rep is a repertory theatre

explanation.surface: A ridiculous bill hangs outside a playhouse, put there by an elderly American.
explanation.definitionFit: Preposterous means ridiculous, contrary to reason.

clue.text: Do an emergency stop? This could make things sticky!

definitions.meaning: braking hard and suddenly in a car
read literally, spreading fruit preserve on a car's stopping mechanism

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means to brake suddenly, and literally describes smearing preserve on the brakes.

clue.text: Over-precise lookout unknown outside European navy

indicators.note: outside says the first pieces surround the next

parts.note: a picket is a sentry or soldier on watch
RN is the Royal Navy
y is a mathematical unknown

explanation.surface: A fussy sentry stands outside a European navy's base.
explanation.definitionFit: A fussy person is overly particular about small details.

clue.text: Broadcast, say, rejected by English adviser

indicators.note: by places one piece beside the other
rejected turns the pieces back to front

parts.note: to air something is to broadcast it
eg means for example, as does say

explanation.surface: An English adviser turns down a broadcast proposal.
explanation.walkthrough: Egeria was a water nymph who advised a Roman king, hence a name for any female counsellor.
explanation.definitionFit: In Roman legend Egeria was the nymph who counselled King Numa, so the name means a female counsellor.

clue.text: Main contract identifying source of fish-eggs?

parts.note: the main is an old word for the sea
to purse lips is to contract them

explanation.surface: A maritime agreement points to where fish eggs come from.
explanation.definitionFit: A sea purse is the horny egg case of a skate or shark, which holds its eggs.

clue.text: It draws attention to passage some master is marking

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A teacher marking work flags a passage for attention.
explanation.definitionFit: A group of three asterisks printed to draw a reader's attention to a passage of text.

clue.text: Lacking means of identification, unlike Lloyd's of London

definitions.meaning: the investors who back the London insurance market are called Names, so it has plenty

explanation.definitionFit: It means anonymous, and Lloyd's of London is famous for its underwriting members known as Names.

clue.text: Low circular enclosure where boat is secured

parts.note: to low is the noise cattle make, a moo
a ring is a round enclosure, like a show ring

explanation.surface: A low round pen marks where a boat is tied up.
explanation.definitionFit: A berth or anchorage where a vessel is made fast.

clue.text: Extortionist bound to divide an ancient city

indicators.note: dividing the city means sitting inside it

parts.note: Ur was an ancient city of Mesopotamia
bound, as in bound to happen, means sure

explanation.surface: A blackmailer is set on splitting an old city.
explanation.definitionFit: A moneylender charging extortionate interest is an extortionist.

clue.text: One may undertake delivery of a variety of lines

definitions.text: One may undertake delivery of a variety of lines

parts.words: One may undertake delivery of a variety of lines
parts.note: delivery here is speaking aloud, and the lines are verse or text, not parcels or routes

explanation.definitionFit: A person who recites poems or texts aloud delivers many kinds of lines.

clue.text: Creditor seizing Fitzgerald's stock of wine

indicators.note: seizing means holding the next piece inside

parts.note: Ella Fitzgerald was the American jazz singer

explanation.surface: A creditor seizes F Scott Fitzgerald's wine collection.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests the novelist F Scott Fitzgerald; the singer Ella is wanted.
explanation.definitionFit: A cellar is a store of wine kept by a person or house.

clue.text: Peevish character's allusion to another clue, perhaps

parts.note: peevish means irritable, cross
a character reference is a testimonial

explanation.surface: A grumpy character refers to another clue.
explanation.definitionFit: A pointer from one place in a text to another, as a clue referring to another entry, is this.

clue.text: Ancient ship's lading? Not at first

indicators.note: the first letter is dropped

parts.note: lading is a ship's load, cargo

explanation.surface: Ancient vessel's freight puzzle? Not at first.
explanation.definitionFit: Jason sailed on the Argo in Greek legend to find the Golden Fleece.

clue.text: Lamb, priest's second for sacrifice

parts.note: Eli was the priest who raised Samuel in the Bible

indicators.note: second picks the second letter of sacrifice

explanation.surface: A lamb, a priest's next choice for sacrifice.
explanation.walkthrough: Lamb is the essayist Charles Lamb, who wrote as Elia, not the animal.
explanation.definitionFit: Charles Lamb's pen name for his essays was Elia.

clue.text: He sticks up for his employer, one who mails accounts

definitions.text: He sticks up for his employer

parts.note: a bill is an account of money owed
a poster is one who posts letters

explanation.surface: A loyal worker defends his boss while sending out invoices.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sticks up for' suggests defending, but here it means pasting notices on walls.
explanation.definitionFit: A billposter pastes up advertising posters on behalf of whoever hires him.

clue.text: Area abandoned by painter backing a system of meditation

indicators.note: backing turns the remainder back to front
the area letter leaves the painter's name

parts.note: Goya was the Spanish painter

explanation.surface: A painter turns to a system of meditation after leaving an area.
explanation.walkthrough: The Spanish painter loses his final letter, as 'abandoned by' says, and 'backing' turns what remains around before the closing a.
explanation.definitionFit: Yoga is a Hindu discipline of breathing, postures and meditation.

clue.text: Endlessly make impact on a city opera manager

indicators.note: endlessly drops the final letter

parts.note: to impress is to make an impact on
Rio de Janeiro is a Brazilian city

explanation.surface: A manager endlessly tries to impress a city's opera house.
explanation.definitionFit: An impresario organises and manages opera or concert productions.
